profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a background in Electrical Engineering and signal processing, currently pursuing an M.S. in Computer Science at Georgia Tech.

I work primarily in C++ on systems that interface closely with hardware, digital signal processors, and real-time components. My experience spans embedded-adjacent development, signal processing pipelines, and performance critical software.

positions.description: Skills: Signal Processing · Digital Signal Processors · Digital Signal Processing

positions.description: Responsible for assisting students with network issues and data closet management.
